description: Who may receive which domain event (FR-LIV-05, FR-DSH-06). Decided on the server from the session and the data, never by a client. `user` is the owner of the attempt, `org` the company that owns the assessment of a candidate attempt, `admin` every signed-in admin. The relay resolves these from the attempt; a publisher never names a user or a company by hand. Learner practice never reaches an org (D-05, the privacy wall). While OI-15 (when a candidate sees results) is open, the candidate does not receive their own milestones, captures or score live; the recruiter does.
